summary: The timing log of a designated test client (stui, phone_client) starts with a line giving the wall-clock time its at_ms counts from

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A diagnostic log only, written when STUI_TIMING_LOG or --timing is set: one extra first line of type start. No product, wire or client behavior change.
